admission.justification: The three finalization designs were weighed with grounds in DEC-R57CDH and carried here, and the distinction binds all future archive-route claims.

alternatives.option: Finalizing a master never archives it. Explicit retire_master is the individual-master archive route; archive_sprint is the whole-sprint route. When a sprint commands the master, retirement removes it from the sprint in the same step.
alternatives.reason: Preserves the L41 finalization constraint and developer D41/D47 rulings while admitting the ruled whole-sprint operation beside individual retirement.

alternatives.option: Archive a master when it is finalized.
alternatives.reason: Carried from DEC-R57CDH: it moves a folder the sprint still names and runs the deleting hook nobody asked for.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A sprint no longer requires commanded masters to resolve to live folders and hook deletions become reversible.

alternatives.option: At finalization, archive only the masters that no sprint commands.
alternatives.reason: Carried from DEC-R57CDH: never happened on landed code and deletes artifacts without a request to get rid of the master.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The developer asks for standalone-master finalization to archive it.

consequences: Finalization keeps never archiving; individual masters retire explicitly; whole sprints archive by archive_sprint with staying masters named.
context: DEC-R57CDH (L41) states global archive exclusivity for retire_master; MIK-R82@v1 rule 1 admits archive_sprint moving exclusive masters with their sprint. The distinction needs recording without touching finalization never archiving.
decider: Curator succession under M1 L82-MEM-M1-F05; original decider developer D41/D47 with architect run-2 ruling 2.
